from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the provided collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers from the provided collection that this paper cites")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregate of all papers found in the collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
